event_chain.summary: Multisig wallet control transferred via manipulated payload

summary: On July 18, 2024 attackers stole more than $230 million from one of Indian crypto exchange WazirX's multi-signature wallets. WazirX said a mismatch between what its custody provider Liminal's interface displayed and what signers actually approved let the payload be replaced to transfer wallet control to the attacker. Elliptic and ZachXBT said the attack bore hallmarks of North Korea's Lazarus Group. WazirX paused trading and launched a bounty program.
